before.alt: A hard-boiled fantasy noir poster: a trench-coat-wearing Dragonborn detective (Zaps) snarls through fog while swinging a lightning-charged greataxe at writhing snake abominations. Behind him, a calm firbolg puzzle-solver, a shady druid in sunglasses, a wide-eyed halfling with sentient bagpipes, and a cheerful spider-limbed warforged float in smoky grayscale shadows. The scene is moody, dramatic, and very aware that the world absolutely did not let them go.

before.alt: An anime-style fantasy poster titled “The Queen Who Refused to Die.” At the top, a regal queen with a crown stares forward, half of her face cracked and transformed into stone, her expression calm but haunting. Below her, a dragonborn detective in a fedora and trench coat smokes a cigarette, rendered in stylized anime detail. Beneath him, a group of adventurers stand together: a young halfling bard playing bagpipes, a horned firbolg woman with a determined expression, a dwarven druid wearing sunglasses, and a glowing-eyed warforged. In the background, a ruined jungle temple rises through mist while winged pterafolk descend from the sky. The composition blends anime character design with a dark, cinematic atmosphere.
